verdict.rationale: Autumn is a Stripe-based billing and entitlements layer, so a sandbox or test mode for payment flows is a fair question for it. The pack never mentions a sandbox environment, test mode, test cards, or simulating declines and disputes. What it does show is plan previews, charge previews via previewAttach, and running the open-source dashboard locally, none of which amounts to a production-mirroring payment test mode.
